# Aditya Jethani

> AI/ML Engineer with 1.5+ years building and deploying production RAG, agentic, computer-vision and backend systems across legal-tech, healthcare and e-commerce. Computer Engineering graduate from Pandit Deendayal Energy University (CGPA 9.44/10). Based in Surat, Gujarat, India.

## Summary

Aditya Jethani is an AI/ML Engineer at Logicwind. He specialises in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, LLM fine-tuning (QLoRA), computer vision, and the ML systems work (GPU-batched inference, evaluation, observability) that takes models to production. He measures everything and optimises until latency, accuracy and robustness targets are met.

## Experience

- Machine Learning Engineer, Logicwind (Dec 2025 - Present): Production multi-agent systems (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangFuse), an agentic RAG platform over 360K multilingual documents, an agentic NL-to-SQL voice interface, and applied research on deterministic document parsing (CER 0.0135, token-F1 0.99).
- Software Engineer, AI/ML, CybraneX (Jun 2025 - Dec 2025): 9x RAG inference speedup (110s to 12.2s), 139.6 tokens/sec sustained, a clinical tongue-analysis computer-vision system (94.2% color and 91.7% coating accuracy), and an Azure-deployed enterprise document-extraction product.
- Software Engineering Intern, Yanolja Cloud Solutions (Jan 2025 - Jun 2025): Image-to-image translation for multilingual e-commerce (50% accuracy lift), an automated code-review system on Google Cloud, and Go/Python/FFmpeg vision pipelines.
- Machine Learning Intern, CybraneX (May 2024 - Oct 2024): AI telemarketing system handling 50,000+ daily calls at 89% lead accuracy.

## Selected projects

- TalentScout AI: candidate-screening assistant (LangChain, LangGraph, Llama 3.3 70B). https://aitalentscout.streamlit.app/
- Prompt Detective: reverse-engineers prompts from AI-generated media (OpenCV, CLIP). https://promptdetective.streamlit.app/
- Grade Flow: RAG grading platform (FastAPI, LangGraph, pgvector). https://gradeflow.streamlit.app/
- Tongue Analysis AI: clinical computer-vision diagnostics (PyTorch, OpenCV).
- Scrollwise: full-stack digital-wellbeing app and Chrome extension (Next.js, Express, MongoDB).
- Neural ODE for Heart Rate: continuous-time ICU heart-rate modelling on MIMIC-III (PyTorch, torchdiffeq).
